claim_one_line: THE GENERICITY CONTROL BITES -- BUT ON 2 OF 5 TONES, AND THE SEALED PREDICTION WAS WRONG. Phase-0 item 0, commissioned by cc on the owner's D-2 ruling; preregistered and SHA-256 sealed (f272c0065249da306e2df510ad67d5d1273cacd57aa84828a9ff1e8aa006f4f0, 9416 bytes) before the script existed, three outcomes fixed, PREDICTION RECORDED (OUTCOME B) so the arc could be wrong. Under test was cc3's OWN 2026-08-12 crossing proposal -- that a scale-divided spectral quantity lands on the five tones {0, 1/(2phi), 1/2, phi/2, 1} = |chi|/2 over 2I -- against S034's N5 and B518's own 'substitution-universal', which say a prediction true of ALL aperiodic order discriminates NOTHING. THE MENUS, computed from multiplicative closure of unit quaternions with no character table typed in: 2T (E6, orders 1,2,3,4,6) gives {0, 1/2, 1}, ENTIRELY RATIONAL; 2O (E7, orders 1,2,3,4,6,8) gives {0, 1/2, sqrt2/2, 1}, carrying the SILVER signature; 2I (E8, orders 1,2,3,4,5,6,10) gives the five tones. PREDICTION WRONG: 2O's menu has FOUR tones, not five, so the SHAPE is not generic and the verdict is OUTCOME A by the sealed criterion. BUT THE CONTROL BITES ANYWAY, AND THIS IS THE OPERATIVE CONTENT: {0, 1/2, 1} IS SHARED BY ALL THREE GROUPS, so only phi/2 and 1/(2phi) are golden-unique -- a discriminating fraction of 2/5, meaning 60% of the menu discriminates nothing, and the 2026-08-12 proposal did not distinguish the two cases. THE REPAIR IS FORCED: a tone-level crossing must be stated on phi/2 or 1/(2phi), NEVER on menu membership alone. RESOLUTION REQUIREMENT, fixed in the seal before it was known: the closest distinct golden/silver pair is phi/2 = 0.809016994375 against sqrt2/2 = 0.707106781187, so any experiment resolving worse than 0.101910213188 cannot tell the menus apart at all. BRONZE HAS NO PARTNER, PROVED TWICE: every tone is cos(2 pi j/n) for n an element order and the orders across all three groups are {1,2,3,4,5,6,8,10} with 13 nowhere; independently, sqrt13 in Q(sqrt2,sqrt5) would force Q(sqrt13) to be one of its exactly three quadratic subfields, needing 26, 65 or 130 to be a perfect square, and none is -- so item 3's requested 'silver, bronze' control can be run against silver and CANNOT be run against bronze at the group level, an asymmetry the 2026-08-12 text did not anticipate. AND THE HAZARD IS CONFIRMED ON THE OTHER ROUTE: the metallic trace map for a -> a^m b, b -> a, computed symbolically in Z[x,y,z] via Cayley-Hamilton (x' = p_m z - p_{m-1} y, y' = x, z' = p_{m+1} z - p_m y, reducing at m=1 to B518's T = (z,x,xz-y)), preserves the Fricke invariant I = x^2+y^2+z^2-xyz-4 EXACTLY for m = 1, 2, 3 -- so B518's 'substitution-universal' now has a computed extension along a NEW axis, the metallic index, and the two halves cut in opposite directions: KAPPA IS PROVABLY GENERIC ACROSS GOLDEN, SILVER AND BRONZE so a kappa-based crossing discriminates nothing, while the tone menu is not generic. S034's N5 is CONFIRMED for kappa and REFUTED for the tones -- what the 2026-08-12 document asserted in prose is now computed. SELF-CAUGHT INSTRUMENT FAILURE: the m=1 control failed on first run because the FULL-trace map was paired with the HALF-trace invariant (kappa = X^2+Y^2+Z^2-2XYZ-1 = I/4); the seal said a failure at m=1 means the instrument is broken and the arc reports nothing else, and it did. CONTROLS: exactly one involution per group (the property whose failure retired SL(2,Z/4) = 2O in B997's correction), unit-quaternion representation pinning per B8087's lesson that an isomorphism check is not a representation check, a SECOND ROUTE re-reading every tone from element order alone, and a BITE control showing the instrument can see a null discriminator. NOT ESTABLISHED: that a silver-substitution spectrum would produce 2O's menu -- a non-golden GROUP was matched, and the substitution-to-group linkage for silver runs through order-8 elements, NOT through B997's conductor route since SL(2,Z/8) is not a McKay group; and whether the tones are OBSERVABLES, which is item 2 and remains exactly where it was. No literature was read. Gate 5 untouched: no measured value appears.
